# OpenSmaartLab

Independent real-time acoustic measurement application: real-time FFT and octave-band
RTA, dual-channel transfer function with magnitude, phase and coherence, live impulse
response with RT60 estimation, SPL meter, signal generator, and microphone calibration
that reads Dayton Audio calibration files directly.

Two implementations ship in this repository: a Python/PySide6 reference app and a native
C++/JUCE build with lower latency for serious measurement work.

Independent implementation. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rational Acoustics; it
contains no third-party Smaart source code, artwork, or algorithms.
